title: New Crafting Table
description: A diamond-related crafting table for version 1.21.8
body:
This mod adds a crafting table reserved for diamonds![Table De Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ab9d9d1403a096be7d5f11bcf3a5aff9c421575.png)
To craft it you will need ![Craft de la table de craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/708ad243ae5c8acb4946e4446a9052e0c10ece18.png)
2 diamonds, a brush, 2 chains, and 4 jungle planks.
There are 6 types of crafting.:
the crafting of the diamond nugget![pépite de diamant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9ae888e8c53b77c7c1dc6ce85361d9f9600c4b9.png)![craft de la pépite de diamant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55a060721999726ff8d238252c32d6584fb4e50d_0.webp)
the crafting of the dagger![craft dague](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/315b254a0aca0568a18058f4072edd358a4d0e49_0.webp)
the crafting of the name tag (for the 1.21.8)![craft name tag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81326a4f667ba587e12ad89b1dfc424b83b976a4_0.webp)
diamond crafting![craft diamant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/114cf1978d4e39542026252c15b973dfee22c0f2_0.webp)
mini pickaxe which mines faster

and diamond chain

Have a great gaming session !!!

The next update will be 1.2.0, the mod's biggest update; the mod releases on 1 september of 2026
